title: 3gqi.2.2.1: Renode C# GNSS UART peripheral class — basic NMEA TX
description: Create a minimal Renode C# peripheral (GNSSSimulator : UARTBackend) that reads NMEA sentences from a file or embedded list and writes them to the UART TX buffer at a configurable interval (default 1Hz). No PPS, no dynamic position — just static sentence playback. Register in a .repl as gnss_uart. Test: Renode loads, firmware reads UART, parses GGA sentence.
